column1: # mkexpect.py --reasons for our driver: REGEX<tab>why, first match wins

column2: fragment_ops random/interaction: two-sided stencil drew blank or wrong channels from run to run until its block got the DDK's 27-dword DMA (+45); the rest not looked at yet
cube maps: NPOT faces, the small-face layout (the face stride below 16 texels is a guess), 8/16-bit and ETC1 faces; the DDK fails many of these too
texture uploads: unpack alignment, sub-image updates and copies of 16-bit formats; the DDK fails teximage2d_align too
texture sampling: LOD bias and completeness corner cases
render to texture: shared and recreated colour buffers, resizes; 565/4444/5551 targets stored as RGBA8; the DDK fails the shared/recreate cases too
compiler: random combinations that fail with F16 off too; with the compiler session
wide lines: the hardware's line quads against GL's rule; the DDK fails these too
points from glDrawElements; the DDK fails these too
